allow-hooks.description: Allow already-trusted configured hooks during tool execution; accepted but not applied by this command

allow-writes.description: Enable mutation tools and explicit artifact writes (inspection may still refresh caches and credentials); accepted but not applied by this command

auth-timeout.description: Maximum duration of a browser authorization attempt; accepted but not applied by this command

browser-auth.description: Browser authorization: auto (ask supporting hosts) or never; accepted but not applied by this command

confirmation.description: Mutation approval: host (explicit elicitation) or none (operator-authorized unattended execution); accepted but not applied by this command

no-local-config.description: Ignore .fbrcm.toml repository configuration (env: FBRCM_NO_LOCAL_CONFIG); accepted but not applied by this command

profile.description: Use profile for this invocation without changing the active profile (env: FBRCM_PROFILE); accepted but not applied by this command

request-timeout.description: Maximum duration per tool operation, including queueing and user interaction; accepted but not applied by this command

stateless.description: Run a supported command without profiles or application-managed local state (Firebase API token env: FBRCM_GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN); accepted but not applied by this command

timeout.description: Maximum duration for the complete command; accepted but not applied by this command

toolsets.description: Enabled toolsets: inspect, edit, drafts, plans, publish, diagnostics; accepted but not applied by this command
